search_method: TwexAPI advanced search; to:verified_operator filter:replies, event-date bounds, then exact reference timestamps filtered in memory

rules.x_cluster_ge2: at least 2 distinct authors with explicit internet complaints in same uniquely resolved district and same 15-minute UTC bucket
rules.x_cluster_ge3: at least 3 distinct authors with explicit internet complaints in same uniquely resolved district and same 15-minute UTC bucket
rules.no_geo_inference: no district inferred from account profile, IP, or operator account location

limitations: phrase-based classification is conservative and not population-representative
social complaints are not confirmed outages
only unambiguous unique district names form geo clusters
posts directed to the operator were searched; this does not exhaust all replies below every operator-authored post
no raw text, post IDs, user IDs or handles are stored
No query exhausted the three-page cap: every query with a continuation produced an empty page before stopping; exact event-window posts were retrieved within this bounded search.
